main_text.p: Numer.33.52. Aff. ואת־צלמיו Imagines ejus, 2.Reg.11.18. Chald. צלם Statua quaedam, Dan.2.31. צלמא דכן Statua haec, Ibid. לצלם דהנא Statuae auri, id est, aureae, Dan.3.v.5.

צלע c. Costa: Synecdochicè Latus: Item Claudicatio, quasi lapsum lateris dicas: Substructio, Trabs substructionis, quae lateribus aedificii adhaeret, quasi structuram Lateralem dicas: Cella, Cubiculum laterale, seu ad Latus Templi exstructum: צלע אל־צלע Substructio ad substructionem, Ezech.41.6. את הצלע Costam illam, Gen.2.22. לצלע Ad claudicationem, Psal.38.18. cum Segol, cum aliàs eâ formâ sit Constr. בצלע ההר In latere montis, 2.Sam.16.13. ubi tamen quaedam exemplaria Tzere habent, sed male juxta Kimchiu: Aff. לצלעו Ad Latus ejus, Job.18.12. ובצלעי Et in claudicatione mea, Psal.35. v.15. Plur.Masc. צלעים Valvae, 1.Reg.6.34. Et Foem. צלעות Substructiones, 1.Reg.6.5. Constr. על־צלעת Ad latera arcae, Exod.37.5. בצלעות ארזים Trabibus, Tabulis cedrinis, 1.Reg.6.15. Aff. צלעתיו Lateribus ejus, Exod.30.4. מצלעתיו E costis ejus, Gen.2.21.
צלע m. Claudicans, Claudus, in Latus labens, Gen.32.31. Foem. הצלעה Claudicantem, Mich.4.6.

צמא Sitivit: Præt. צמא Sitio, Jud.4.19. deficiente Aleph: צמאו Sitiunt, Jesa.48.21. צמאה נפשי Sitit anima mea, Psal.42.3. וצמאת Et quùm sitiés, Ruth.2.9. cum Chirek, more Verborum Quiescentium tertiâ ה. Futur. ויצמא Et sitivit, Exod.17.3.
צמא m. Sitiens, Sitibundus, Jesa.21.14. Plural. צמאים

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points are not fully legible in the scan; consonants were transcribed as read. Several Hebrew forms, especially the vowel-pointed ones, may need checking against a reference edition. "Trabs lubstructionis" is printed with a long s and is given as subs-tructionis. Printed "Substructio" and similar long-s forms are normalised to plain s. The Latin words in italics were set in italic type in the print.
